remediation.issue: The rendered-page connector accepts a user-supplied landing URL without documented validation.
remediation.suggestion: Quote the URL argument, allow only HTTP and HTTPS, reject private hosts, and require confirmation before sending URLs to an external crawler.

content.value_statement: Campaigns lose relevance when ads and landing pages make different promises. This skill checks five continuity areas and produces a focused repair list.
actual_capabilities: Compares ad headlines and offers with landing page content.
Checks whether the offer and primary call to action appear above the fold.
Reviews measured or estimated page speed evidence.
Counts required fields and identifies specific form friction.
Checks mobile readability, tap targets, and horizontal scrolling.
Returns Pass, Partial, or Fix results with repair ownership.
limitations: It does not rewrite copy, redesign layouts, or modify forms.
It cannot verify continuity without ad copy and landing page content.
Speed and mobile results remain estimates when measured data is unavailable.
It does not calculate account scores or campaign launch vetoes.

use_cases.title: Preflight a Paid Campaign
use_cases.description: Compare approved ads with the destination page before launch and identify continuity gaps.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Landing Page Relevance
use_cases.description: Review offer visibility, message match, speed evidence, and mobile presentation after a low landing experience rating.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Focused Repair Brief
use_cases.description: Turn page findings into specific tasks for copy, layout, offer, and form owners.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Message Match
prompt_templates.prompt: Check [landing page URL] against these ad headlines: [headlines]. Mark message match as Pass, Partial, or Fix.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use before launching a simple paid campaign.

prompt_templates.title: Five-Check Preflight
prompt_templates.prompt: Preflight [URL] using [ad copy]. Check message match, above-the-fold content, speed, form friction, and mobile rendering.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when all core launch inputs are available.

prompt_templates.title: Rating Diagnosis
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose the below-average landing experience for [URL] using [ads] and [speed data]. Label every metric by evidence type.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use after an advertising platform reports weak landing experience.

prompt_templates.title: Multi-Ad Continuity Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare each ad in [campaign export] with [URL]. Identify unsupported promises, prioritize blockers, and assign one repair owner per finding.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a campaign with several ads and shared destinations.

output_examples.input: Check the spring sale ad against the product landing page.
output_examples.output: Message match: Fix. The ad promises 25 percent off, but the first viewport shows no discount. Route the offer issue to the page owner.

output_examples.input: Review the lead form page with mobile render evidence and PageSpeed results.
output_examples.output: Mobile: Pass. Speed: Partial, measured from PageSpeed. Form friction: Fix because seven required fields include company size and phone number.

output_examples.input: Preflight a page when no speed report is available.
output_examples.output: Speed: Estimated. No measured load data was supplied. Review visible page weight and request PageSpeed evidence before final launch approval.

best_practices: Provide the exact live ad copy and destination page content.
Include measured PageSpeed or mobile render evidence when available.
Verify every Fix against one specific promise, field, metric, or viewport issue.
anti_patterns: Do not request invented speed, conversion, or Core Web Vitals figures.
Do not treat estimated observations as measured results.
Do not use this skill to redesign the page or score the advertising account.

faq.question: What inputs does the skill need?
faq.answer: Provide the destination URL or page copy, the related ad copy, the promised offer, and the campaign profile.

faq.question: Does it change my landing page?
faq.answer: No. It identifies gaps and routes repairs to the appropriate page, offer, or account workflow.

faq.question: Can it work without page speed data?
faq.answer: Yes. It labels speed and mobile observations as Estimated until measured data is available.

faq.question: What does the report contain?
faq.answer: It covers message match, above-the-fold content, speed, form friction, and mobile rendering with Pass, Partial, or Fix labels.

faq.question: Does it calculate Quality Score?
faq.answer: No. It checks landing page relevance factors but does not calculate platform or account scores.

faq.question: Can it analyze multiple ads?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide each ad headline or hook and identify the landing page used by each ad.
